title: Motion by @_remocn: Introducing Remocn Studio. Waitlist for early access. This is what I'v
notes:
Introducing Remocn Studio. Waitlist for early access. This is what I've been working on for the past several months. I made every video in Claude Code, and over and over I kept repeating the same thing. "Why not build myself an app that gets rid of this," I thought So I built it. Realized it would help a lot of people. This isn't just another AI video editor. There are no timelines, keyframes, or any of the other stuff every editor has. You can't trim a video by clicking on a timeline, you can't manage tracks. All you can do is prompt Remocn Studio is the director's chair. Here, you direct the people making the video. You watch the process. "Fix the text here" "The animation is too fast here" "Why the f*k did everything break here"

Designer: @_remocn. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
